instruction: Update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc in the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment using its CLI/API tools, and save the finished model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. For this task, Bonsai is installed as a Blender extension, so start `/opt/blender/blender` and use the Bonsai tools from that environment. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a small shell-and-door package prepared for facilities classification. Preserve the existing four-wall enclosure, slab, door, shell geometry, and opening relationship. Use OmniClass Table 23 - Products (2012 edition) and apply these exact classification references: all four exterior walls = 23-13 21 13, Exterior Walls; the floor slab = 23-13 31 13, Floor Slabs; and the entrance door = 23-17 11 00, Doors. Treat the entrance as external with IsExternal set to true and give it a FireRating of 60min. Stamp the four walls, floor slab, and entrance door with revision code BONSAI-CLI-10.
